kind: growth-etf-screening universe manifest (written before any performance screening)

rules.D1: first regular bar 2016-01-04; a regular bar on every NYSE session through 2026-10-30; none on a closed day (timestamps only)
rules.D2: datasets verify status verified; file sha256 = its dataset report = Study 9 S0 record
rules.D3: no split-sized (≥ 30%) overnight move without a registered split: Study 9 S0 whole file; re-checked here on split-adjusted development sessions; no non-positive price
rules.D4: no leveraged, inverse, volatility, single-commodity-futures or ETN product (Study 9 S0 classification)
rules.D5: development median regular-session daily dollar volume ≥ $10,000,000 and development median minute coverage ≥ 25% (Study 9 S0)

commonCalendar.how: every eligible file: dataset report calendar audit 2016-01-04 → 2026-10-30 with 0 missing sessions (timestamps only); development calendars identical session by session on the D24 doors

limitations: The universe is the repository’s present inventory: survivorship and availability bias (funds that closed or were never downloaded are absent).

Every eligible ETF was examined before by D1 studies over 2016–2026; Growth (this engine) was examined only on VGT and GDX (and XBI in engine checks). 2025–2026 is previously examined history, not an untouched holdout.
Price only: dividends, distributions and special distributions appear as price drops while a position is held; bond and high-distribution funds are therefore understated relative to total return.
Index methodology and constituent changes inside 2016–2026 (e.g. sector reclassifications) are part of each fund’s history and are not adjusted.
